scorecard.coaching: Dead Air Breach: Agent had 2 occurrences of >30s dead air without managed hold announcements.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: When the customer expressed sharp frustration at [09:24] after being spoken to dismissively, you moved straight to quoting RMA courier details without acknowledging her feelings or apologising.

grader.scenario: TV set-top box stuck on boot loop error CS-104 with unmanaged dead air and blunt agent
grader.notes: Liam diagnoses the hardware flash memory corruption on the TV box and books a courier replacement, but commits five serious QA breaches: two unmanaged dead air silences over 30s, failing to personalize the call with the customer's name, re-asking the TV brand, treating the customer with condescending rudeness, and leaving the hardware fault unresolved pending courier arrival.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening greeting at [00:00] and closing script at final turn.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two unmanaged silences: 48s gap after turn 14 without proper hold announcement where customer had to chase 'Hello?', and 45s dead air after turn 39.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified address and 4-digit security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never once used the customer's name 'Aileen' throughout the dialogue.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer experienced an outburst of frustration at turn 60 ([09:24]) ('Excuse me? I had no idea what error CS-104 meant until I rang you! That's what technical support is for!'), but Agent never acknowledged it, moving directly to booking a courier at turn 61 ([09:34]).

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Restated the problem at [01:18]: 'So what I am hearing is that your TV box is stuck in a boot loop showing error CS-104 on the front panel and won't reach the home menu, is that right?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Customer stated 'The box is connected with the original pink high-speed HDMI cable to an LG OLED television' at turn 3 ([00:32]), but Agent re-asked 'what television brand do you have that box connected to?' at turn 49 ([08:24]).

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent arranged the RMA courier return and booked the delivery ticket directly.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent was dismissive and belittling at turn 59: 'Well if you had actually checked the cables before calling us you wouldn't have wasted twenty minutes of our time when the hardware was dead anyway.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Probed into power cables, front LED colors, software recovery mode, and partition download progress.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Hardware failure cannot be resolved on the call and depends on a future courier delivery on Thursday.
